stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Skye reaches out to Micro, a hacker from the Rising Tide, for help decoding the strange alien symbols. He passes along word of a murder victim carved with them, which puts Coulson's team on the killer's trail.
stages.whoA: Micro, a Rising Tide hacker who helps her trace the alien symbols.
stages.whoB: Skye, a Rising Tide hacker he helps track down a killer.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Eros is the brother of Thanos. When he arrives on the Domo, Pip introduces him as Eros, prince of Titan and brother to Thanos.
stages.whoB: His brother Eros, a prince of Titan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey finds Peter's undelivered letter to MJ and tracks her down through Ned's posts. She possesses MJ, kisses Peter in her body, then makes her leap from a rooftop, and Spider-Man catches her.
stages.whoA: Peter's lost love. She possesses her to get to Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: The telepath who possesses her to get to Spider-Man.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Reva Connors gets hold of the files on the experiments done on Kilgrave as a child and buries them. He takes control of her to find them, then tells Jessica Jones to take care of her, and Jessica kills Reva under his control.
stages.whoA: She hid the files on his childhood. He has Jessica kill her.
stages.whoB: He controls her to find the files, then has Jessica kill her.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Xavier finds Kurt with Cerebro after the attack on the President and sends Storm and Jean to bring him in. At Alkali Lake, Kurt teleports Storm into Stryker's Cerebro to break Jason's hold on Xavier, then teleports the Professor out as the dam gives way.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler. He finds him with Cerebro, and Kurt helps rescue him.
stages.whoB: Professor X. He tracks Kurt down, and Kurt helps rescue him.
